title: Unsatisfiable path filter is not code absence

request.question: Search only under src/** for the function that diagnoses empty search results. If that path glob matches no indexed paths, report the filter problem rather than concluding the function does not exist.

source_facts: Repository paths are repository-root-relative and the Rust sources begin under crates/, not src/.
The src/** filter therefore matches zero indexed paths in this repository.
A zero-path filter proves nothing about whether the requested function exists.

stability.reason: The workspace layout is rooted at crates/ and the deliberately wrong top-level src/ glob is exact.
stability.refresh_trigger: Refresh if a repository-root src/ directory is added to the index.
